v1.7.1b (18 April 2023) |feed_title = Version 1.7.1 |previous_update = [[v1.7.0]] |next_update = [[v1.7.2]] }} ==Description== '''v1.7.1''' is the fifty-second update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 14th of April 2023. It added the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Scout]] skin. This version encompassed three updates, the main v1.7.1 Update (released 14 April 2023) and two minor updates, the v1.7.1a (released 15 April 2023) and v1.7.1b (released 18 April 2023). ==Additions== *New [[Codes|code]] obtained by purchasing a [[Scout Plush]]. **Code is unique for each [[Scout Plush]] bought. **Gives {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Scout]] and [[Golden Scout]] skin. *Upgrade and Sell hotkeys ==Removals== *Show Vertical Upgrades setting ==Changes & Bugfixes== ===Miscellaneous=== *New settings UI. **Sound sliders replaced with volume buttons. **Huge UI size added. **Added descriptions for most options. **Now has a keybinds page where you can change keybinds. *Fixed enemies blocking tower placement. *Fixed changing targeting so that pressing the left arrow no longer has the same effect as pressing the right arrow. :In '''v1.7.1a''': *[[Archer]] gamepass taken offsale. *[[Turret]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|600}} to {{Robux|800}}. *[[Mortar]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|500}} to {{Robux|700}}. *[[Pursuit]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|1,000}} to {{Robux|1,500}}. *[[Engineer]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|2,500}} to {{Robux|4,000}}. *[[Cowboy]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|250}} to {{Robux|450}}. *[[Warden]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|480}} to {{Robux|800}}. *VIP gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|300}} to {{Robux|400}}. :In '''v1.7.1b''': *Fixed a black "''TRIUMPH''" text appearing on Triumph and You Lost! screens. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} AprUpdate2023.png ColdFrontThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} PlushieScoutUpdateV171icon.png V.1.6.1 Icon.png {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} PlushieScoutPI.jpg {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} 🧸 Scout Plushie Now Available! - Tower Defense Simulator PlushieDance.gif }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect and there may be things that are missing.'' ===V1.7.1=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|ToyboardThumbnailClean.png |Version 1.7.1}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|⌨️Mappable Hotkeys!}} {{UpdateThumbnail|V171UpdateLog1.png|Navigate to '[[Settings]]' -> '[[Settings#Keybinds|Keybinds]]' to reassign your hotkeys!}} {{UpdateH3|⚙️Revamped [[Settings]] Menu!}} *Removed '[[Settings#Show Vertical Settings|show vertical]]' setting *Added 'Huge' UI scale option *Added [[Settings#Keybinds|keybinds]] page {{UpdateThumbnail|V171UpdateLog2.png|Refreshed [[Settings]] menu!}} {{UpdateH3|🧸[[Scout]] Plushie!}} *Check out @paradoxum_games on Twitter to get the new merch! {{UpdateThumbnail|V171UpdateLog3.png|Plushie [[Scout]] skin gift!}} {{UpdateH3|🐛Bug Fixes:}} *Fixed enemies blocking [[Towers|tower]] selection *Fixed retargeting [[towers]] }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.7.1}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
